action: The date: JUNE THIRTEENTH, FOUNDERS' NIGHT, the Armory. A photo of Adrian Vale (tall, gray, courteous, good coat) with giant scissors in one hand and a small black notebook in the other. A grid of nine photos: the notebook in all nine. 'Who brings a notebook to a ribbon-cutting?' JC looks at it longer than he wants. Triptych flash: ledger man's book / thin man's notebook / Vale's notebook.
